title: Man with Cosmic Orbs
description: A central man in a dark coat stands with arms outstretched, holding two transparent orbs. The left orb contains a small alien creature, while the right holds a tiny human figure on a planet. Behind him is a surreal lavender landscape with floating faces, crystal formations, a striped celestial body, and a lone walking figure on a path.
prompt: A surreal portrait of a serious man in a dark Victorian coat standing at the center with arms spread, holding two glowing orbs in his hands. The left orb contains a small cute alien, the right orb contains a tiny human standing on a planet with rings. Behind him is a dreamlike lavender field with tall crystals, multiple floating identical faces, a lone figure walking a path toward a large striped celestial body in the sky, all framed in an ornate geometric oval border with triangular patterns.
